metadata.title: Brazilian States — Live AI Agent Demo
metadata.description: Alternate React/Next.js frontend for a production Java/Spring Boot REST API, with a BFF route handler forwarding real visitor IPs through Vercel to preserve per-client rate limiting behind the proxy.

confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete {abbreviation}?

abbreviationLengthError: Enter the state abbreviation with 2 letters.

askAiDescription: Ask an AI assistant about Brazilian states using live data from the Estado API.
askAiPlaceholder: E.g.: How many states are in the Southeast region?
askAiError: Failed to reach the assistant. Please try again shortly.
askAiLanguageNote: The assistant only understands questions in Portuguese or English.
askAiHowItWorks: An AI agent (Spring AI + Gemini) queries the live backend API; answers are generated from current data.
askAiSourceLink: View the AI agent source on GitHub
